text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of Matikanefukukitaru's debut has arrived. With the pressure on, she begins to crumble.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she is never alone—for she has the gods on her side!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Remembering this, she offers her prayers with the utmost grace and makes her way onto the track.
